summary: SiteDocument represents a document associated with a Site, containing ID and SiteID fields. Its core use is as a data entity in the HSPnet system, referenced in workflows that display, filter, and validate employment applications related to a site.
purpose: To store and reference documents related to a specific Site for use in filtering, displaying, and managing employment applications and site documentation in HSPnet.
content_gaps: No business rules, workflows, or system behavior explicitly described in the source.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page/class for presenting a welcome interface to administrative staff users in HSPnet. It displays last login information, handles filtering of employment applications, and manages validation and UI controls for date ranges, site, discipline, and application status.
purpose: To provide administrative staff users with a welcome dashboard that shows recent activity, enables filtering and viewing of employment applications, and manages user interface behaviors, including error/warning display and validation.

fields.name: cmdRefreshView
fields.description: Refreshes view based on filter criteria

workflows.name: FilterEmploymentApplications
steps: User selects site, discipline, date range, and withdrawn status.
View is refreshed using cmdRefreshView.
Applications are displayed in gvwApplications via dsEmploymentApplications.
RowDataBound event sets up hyperlinks, email links, and application statuses.

business_rules: StartDate must be before EndDate, validated by checkStartEnd client function.
RequiredFieldValidators enforce that date fields are not empty.
validations: StartDate and EndDate must not be empty (RequiredFieldValidator).
StartDate and EndDate must match date format (RegularExpressionValidator).
StartDate must not be after EndDate (CustomValidator with checkStartEnd).
conditions: Show withdrawn applications only if checked.
system_behavior: Page client script includes additional JS for date handling.
GridView allows paging, data binding, and shows empty template if no data.
Error and warning panels can be hidden and shown based on validation summary.

exceptions.name: NoData
exceptions.description: If no applications are found, display the empty data template.

summary: ServiceCode is an entity used to represent service codes for courses and timetables in HSPnet. It includes fields for code identification, categorization, and localization, and is retrieved via stored procedures for various business scenarios.
purpose: To provide structured code and description data (including alternate languages) for services attached to courses and timetables, used for filtering, display, and sorting in different parts of HSPnet.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Category this service code belongs to

workflows.name: RetrieveServiceCodeListAll
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll with session parameter.
Iterate SqlDataReader, populate ServiceCode objects.
Localize Name if alternate language is selected.

workflows.name: RetrieveServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID with session and CourseID.
Populate ServiceCode objects as above.

workflows.name: RetrieveServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with session and TimetableID.
Populate ServiceCode objects as above.

business_rules: If alternate language fields are active, use NameAlt and NotesAlt instead of Name and Notes.
system_behavior: Service codes are retrieved by stored procedure and localized dynamically.
content_gaps: No explicit UI or actor description; system behaviors rely on context not detailed in the document.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks historical changes to a site profile, including action dates, user actions, fields changed, agency/user details, and support for language localization, with detailed formatting for UI display and tooltip.
purpose: To record, localize, and display the audit trail/history of changes made to site profiles, including who performed the action, which fields were affected, and supporting formatted display for UI/tooltips.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: User ID who did the action

workflows.name: SearchSiteProfileHistory
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch for SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
Populate SiteProfileHistory objects with database record.
Fields localize if alternate language is active.
FillList extracts values for UI display and tooltips.

business_rules: If alternate language fields are active, use alternate values for ScreenSection, UserAction, and Fields.
system_behavior: Audit records are displayed with formatted fields and tooltips.
UserControl supports filtering by SiteID and AgencyID.

summary: EmailPopupDocument manages email popup document entries, providing creation, searching, and deletion capabilities for email-linked files, including file path management and clean-up.
purpose: To support search, display, and safe deletion of email-linked popup documents with file management for HSPnet users.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.description: Path to the file on disk

workflows.name: SearchEmailPopupDocuments
steps: Call Search with DataInfo string.
Split DataInfo into document objects.
Return list of EmailPopupDocument.

workflows.name: DeleteEmailPopupDocument
steps: Call Delete with DataInfo and ID.
Delete file at FilePath, then try to delete folder.
Return new DataInfo string without deleted entry.

validations: Checked field reflects user selection for inclusion/exclusion.
system_behavior: Files and folders are deleted safely with error handling.
Search splits DataInfo into objects for UI display.
dependencies: System.IO for file and directory deletion

exceptions.name: DeleteError
exceptions.description: Catch exceptions if file or folder deletion fails; continue without crashing.

content_gaps: No explicit UI description; actor context is implied but not described.
